claims: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half is scheduled for Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half is organized by New York Road Runners.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half features a 13.1-mile route through New York City.
Over 30,000 participants are expected for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
The first wave of runners sets off around 7:00 a.m. for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
The course of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half begins in Brooklyn near Prospect Park/Brooklyn Museum.
The course of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half finishes near West 68th Street in Central Park, Manhattan.
Runners traverse the Brooklyn Bridge in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Runners run through Times Square in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Coverage will be available on abc7NY.com starting at 7 a.m. EST on March 15, 2026 for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Coverage will be available on ESPN+ starting at 7 a.m. EST on March 15, 2026 for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Extensive street closures will occur in Brooklyn and Manhattan on Sunday morning for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Street closures for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half start around the Brooklyn Museum.
Street closures for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half cross the Brooklyn Bridge.
Street closures for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half occur throughout downtown and midtown Manhattan.
Participants can gain entry to the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half through official charity partners like the Sarcoma Foundation of America.
Participants can gain entry to the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half through official charity partners like Row New York.
